Das Sonnenlicht sammelt sich. Die Antwort tritt klar hervor. Was getan werden muss, steht bereit. Die Zügel liegen in deiner Hand.

Because death is a reality that cannot be undone, there's no reason to hesitate.

Der Wind schmiedet die Klinge, der Himmel wird zur Scheide. Sobald das Schwert gezogen ist, verstummt alles.
Dieses nie verblassende Zyanblau ist ihr Entschluss, ihr Schwur und ihr Ideal.

Forged of flowing wind, sheathed in the azure sky. Once the blade is drawn, all sound falls still.
That never-fading azure is her resolve, her vow, and her ideal.

source: Die Armpanzerung pulsiert mit einer unkontrollierbaren Kraft, die unbeschreibliche Wut aus den Tiefen des unbekannten Sees ausstrahlt. Wenn du sie anlegst, entfessle deinen Zorn auf wehrlose Feinde. Spüre, wie ihre Kraft durch dich durchströmt.
target: The Gauntlets pulsate with an uncontrollable force, emanating unspeakable anger from the depths of the unknown lake. As you don them, unleash your fury on helpless enemies. Feel its power surge through you.

source: Die Geburt revolutionärer Strömungen. Ein Schwert, das für Anfänger-Resonatoren konzipiert ist. Enthält eine nicht zu unterschätzende Kraft unter seinem einfachen Aussehen.
target: The birth of revolutionary tides. A sword designed for novice Resonators. Contains a power not to be underestimated under its simple outlook.

source:
Die tosenden Gezeiten zwingen der Ritterin die Dornenkrone auf – aus ihr schmiedet sie ein Schwert von unermesslicher Stärke.
Ohne die Last der Krone schreitet sie unbeirrt durch die Wellen.
target:
The surging tides force the crown of thorns upon the knight, out of which the knight forges this sword.
Unburdened by the crown, the knight waded through the roaring waves unwaveringly.

source: Diese Armpanzerung ist speziell für Training und Unterricht konzipiert und bietet nur die grundlegendsten Funktionen.

source: Diese Pistolen sind speziell für Training und Unterricht konzipiert und bieten nur die grundlegenden Funktionen.
target: These pistols are designed specifically for training and teaching, offering only the basic features.

source: Diese Waffe ist ein Zeugnis des unzerbrechlichen Blutpakts: Niemals soll man verraten, niemals kapitulieren und bis zum letzten Tropfen Blut kämpfen.
target: This weapon is a testament to the unbreakable blood pact: One shall never betray, never surrender, and fight until the last drop of blood is shed.

source: Dispositivo de projeção que permite mudar a aparência da arma.
target: A projection device that allows you to change the weapon's appearance.

source: Donner wird ihr den Schmerz und die Schwäche ausbrennen. Im Schmelztiegel aus Blut und Sand wird sie nicht länger Staub sein, sondern die strahlende Sonne.
target: Thunder shall purge her pain and weakness. From the crucible of blood and sand, the Sun rises. Not dimmed by dust, but ablaze in her full radiance.

source:
Ein Anker, der einst vom Elfenbein-Torwächter verwendet wurde, um das Somnoire zu stabilisieren.
Doch seit sich Elfenbein-Torwächter in eine weiße Katze verwandelt hat, sieht er jetzt anders aus ...
target:
An anchor once used by Ivory Gatekeeper to stabilize the Somnoire.
However, it now looks different ever since Ivory Gatekeeper transformed into a white cat...

source: Ein Gegenstand zur Änderung des Waffenskins.
target: A projection device that allows you to change the weapon's appearance.

source: Ein Paar Pistolen, bekannt für ihre starke Feuerkraft. Eine leidenschaftliche Überzeugung wird aufkommen, wenn der Schütze diese Pistolen auf dem Schlachtfeld hält.
target: A pair of pistols known for their strong firepower. An impassioned conviction will surge when the shooter holds these pistols on the battlefield.

source: Ein Paar schwerer und starker Armpanzerungen, die sehr zuverlässig sind. Sie können zerstörerische Kraft freisetzen, um tödliche Schläge zu verursachen, wenn sie von erfahrenen Benutzern ausgerüstet sind.
target: A pair of heavy and strong gauntlets with great reliability. It can unleash destructive power to deal fatal blows when equipped by proficient users.

source: Ein absteigendes Adagio. Diese Armpanzerungen pulsieren mit der Kraft aufsteigender Wellen und zerschmettern alles auf ihrem Weg wie eine tödliche Hymne.
target: A descending adagio. These gauntlets pulsate with the power of surging waves, shattering anything in their path like a deadly hymn.

source: Ein absteigendes Adagio. Dieser Gleichrichter öffnet ein aufschlussreiches Fenster zur Situation und ändert die Melodie des intensiven Schlacht-Concertos.
target: A descending adagio. This rectifier opens up an insightful window into the situation, changing the tune of the intense battle concerto.

source: Ein absteigendes Adagio. Dieses Breitschwert dominiert das Schlachtfeld mit der Kraft der Dissonanz. Der Vorhang fällt nie auf ein Meisterwerk.
target: A descending adagio. This broadblade dominates the battlefield with the power of discordance. The curtain never falls on a masterpiece.

source: Ein anerkannt gesegnetes Schwert, da es zu unzähligen Triumphen beigetragen hat. „Möge der Sieg mit dir sein.“
target: A sword of recognized blessing since it has contributed to countless triumphs. "May victory be with you."

source: Ein aufsteigendes Crescendo. Diese Pistolen entfesseln Kugeln mit der Kraft des Donners, die den Himmel wie eine Symphonie der Zerstörung durchreißen.
target: An ascending crescendo. These pistols unleash bullets with the force of thunder, tearing through the heavens like a symphony of destruction.

source: Ein aufsteigendes Crescendo. Dieses bezaubernde Schwert schneidet mühelos durch alles auf seinem Weg, wie ein glorreiches Präludium.
target: An ascending crescendo. This enchanting sword effortlessly cuts through anything in its way, like a glorious prelude.

source:
Eine Projektion des Breitschwerts Zeitalter der Ernte, so anmutig wie Pfirsichblüten.
Mit dem Eintreffen des Frühlings färbt sich die Zeitperle am Heft rosa – getränkt von Blüten, wie das Herz eines Mädchens in voller Blüte.
target:
A projection of Broadblade - Ages of Harvest, as lovely as peach blossoms.
With spring's arrival, the temporal pearl on the hilt turns pink, dyed by petals, like the heart of a girl in bloom.

source: Eine Waffe zum Gedenken an die Kameradschaft der Mitternachtsranger. „Dünne Kleidungsstücke weichen eisigen Monden, während Rüstungen der Kälte der Sterne standhalten.“
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' comradeship. "Thin garments yield to icy moons, while armor withstands the chill of stars."

source: Eine Waffe, die entworfen wurde, um den Mut der Mitternachtsranger zu gedenken. „Tausend Echos tragen die Geschichte des Krieges, während die Geister in den hallenden Schluchten des Mutes vereint sind.“
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' courage. "A thousand echoes carry the war's tale, as spirits unite in resounding gorges of valor.”

source: Eine Waffe, die entworfen wurde, um den wachsamen Schutz der Mitternachtsranger für Jinzhou zu gedenken. „Richte deinen Blick gen Norden, wo die Silhouette der Stadt verblasst, ihre Tore verhüllt vom ruhigen Regen.“
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' vigilant protection of Jinzhou. "Cast your gaze towards the north, where the city's silhouette fades, its gates veiled by the tranquil rain."

source: Eine Waffe, die entworfen wurde, um die Bereitschaft der Mitternachtsranger zu gedenken. „Der Herbst verblasst in endlosen Nächten, bereite Klingen leuchten mit stiller Macht.“
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' preparedness. "Autumn fades in endless nights, ready blades gleam with silent might."

source: Eine Waffe, die zum Gedenken an den Einsatz der Mitternachtsranger entworfen wurde. „Lass meinen Körper brennen, Flammen tanzen, um den Dunst allen Bösen zu vertreiben.“
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' dedication. "Let my body ablaze, flames dance to banish all evil's haze."

source: Eine vor-Lamento Schmiedetechnik wird verwendet, die das Breitschwert trotz seines sperrigen Aussehens leicht und handlich macht. Summende Geräusche sind zu hören, wenn der Träger zuschlägt, wie ein Lied aus der Urzeit.
target: A pre-Lament forging technique is used, rendering the broadblade lightweight and handy with its cumbersome-looking body. Buzzing sounds can be heard when the wielder slashes, like a croon from time immemorial.

source: Um par de manoplas pesadas e fortes com grande confiabilidade. Pode liberar um poder destrutivo para desferir golpes fatais quando equipadas por usuários proficientes.
target: A pair of heavy and strong gauntlets with great reliability. It can unleash destructive power to deal fatal blows when equipped by proficient users.

source: Um par de pistolas conhecidas por seu forte poder de fogo. Uma convicção apaixonada surgirá quando o atirador segurar estas pistolas no campo de batalha.
target: A pair of pistols known for their strong firepower. An impassioned conviction will surge when the shooter holds these pistols on the battlefield.

source: Uma arma projetada para homenagear a camaradagem dos Patrulheiros da Meia-noite. “Roupas finas cedem às luas geladas, enquanto a armadura resiste ao frio das estrelas.”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' comradeship. "Thin garments yield to icy moons, while armor withstands the chill of stars."

source: Uma arma projetada para homenagear a coragem dos Patrulheiros da Meia-noite. “Mil ecos narram a guerra, enquanto os espíritos se erguem unidos em desfiladeiros ressonantes de bravura.”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' courage. "A thousand echoes carry the war's tale, as spirits unite in resounding gorges of valor.”

source: Uma arma projetada para homenagear a dedicação dos Patrulheiros da Meia-noite. “Que meu corpo arda, e que as chamas dancem para dissipar a névoa de todo mal.”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' dedication. "Let my body ablaze, flames dance to banish all evil's haze."

source: Uma arma projetada para homenagear a prontidão dos Patrulheiros da Meia-noite. “O outono se desvanece em noites intermináveis, lâminas prontas brilham com força silenciosa.”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' preparedness. "Autumn fades in endless nights, ready blades gleam with silent might."

source: Uma arma projetada para homenagear a vigilante proteção dos Patrulheiros da Meia-noite de Jinzhou. “Lance seu olhar para o norte, onde a silhueta da cidade se desvanece, seus portões velados pela chuva tranquila.”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' vigilant protection of Jinzhou. "Cast your gaze towards the north, where the city's silhouette fades, its gates veiled by the tranquil rain."

source: Uma espada de bênção reconhecida, pois contribuiu para inúmeros triunfos. “Que a vitória esteja com você.”
target: A sword of recognized blessing since it has contributed to countless triumphs. "May victory be with you."

source:

Em Sonúmia, a forma de uma arma é apenas uma miragem, enquanto seu propósito — uma ferramenta de guerra — permanece verdadeiro como sempre.
target:
A conceptual projection, transparent gauntlets as if they were made of nothing.
In Somnoire, a weapon's form is but a mirage, while its purpose—a tool of war—holds true as ever.

Com a chegada da primavera, a pérola temporal no punho se torna rosa, tingida pelas pétalas, como o coração de uma jovem em flor.

A projection of Broadblade - Ages of Harvest, as lovely as peach blossoms.
With spring's arrival, the temporal pearl on the hilt turns pink, dyed by petals, like the heart of a girl in bloom.

source: Uma técnica de forja pré-Lamento é usada, tornando o espadão leve e prático com seu corpo de aparência desajeitado. Sons de zumbido podem ser ouvidos quando o portador golpeia, como um sussurro de tempos imemoriais.

source: Uma versão melhorada de um modelo de espada produzida em massa desenvolvida em Huanglong. Com sua lâmina elegante e design minimalista, esta espada é exclusivamente criada para as mãos habilidosas de guerreiros experientes.

source: Uma versão melhorada de um modelo de espadão produzido em massa desenvolvido em Huanglong. Com seu desempenho formidável e tecnologias inovadoras, este espadão carrega um peso que só pode ser manejado por guerreiros experientes.

source: „Die Gnade des Hütenden, wie süß du bist. Unser Heim war verloren, doch nun endlich gefunden. Mit Zweigen zwischen meinen Schnäbeln trotze ich den Wellen. Gebunden durch Liebe, sind wir mit heiligem Licht gekrönt.“

source:
かつて白きゲートキーパーが心の集域を安定させるために使用していたアンカー。
白きゲートキーパーが白猫の姿に変化した後、この装置の外観もいくらか変わったようだ……
target:
An anchor once used by Ivory Gatekeeper to stabilize the Somnoire.
However, it now looks different ever since Ivory Gatekeeper transformed into a white cat...

source:
すべての規則は観測可能、すべての現象は分析可能。
何光年も遠くにある理想に、この両手が届き得るのと同じように。
target:
Every pattern can be observed. Every phenomenon can be understood.
The ideal may lie light-years away, yet the path toward it rests within her own hands.

source:
すべての陽の光があなたを照らした。答えはすぐそこにある。
やらなければならないことがあるのだ、あなたにしか成し遂げられないことが。
一歩踏み出そう、太陽のもっと近くへ。
target:
Sunlight gathers. The answer is made plain.
What must be done awaits. The Rein is in your hand.
Step forward, toward the sunlit end.

source: それは感情を持たぬ精確な時計の如く、着実に、容赦なく、裁きの到来を告げている――全ての罪を呑み込む焔光にして、夜の闇を打ち払う暁の光。
target: It heralds justice, precise and inexorable as a clock's toll. All sins are cleansed in flame, dissipating like night beneath the dawn's gaze.

source:
たった一振りの刃で、この果てしない夜を切り裂くことは叶うのか。彼女はただ答えを求め、ひたすらに前へと歩み続ける。
行き場を失い、細かく砕かれた無数の願い。それは彼女の血へと溶け込み、今も熱く燃え滾りながら、その鼓動を刻んでいる。
target:
How keen a blade it takes to impale this unrelenting night?
She presses ever forward for the answer, those unbound wishes roaring in her veins.

source: 为纪念夜归战士对今州的守护而打造的音感仪。有诗赞曰：“湖城北望荒石岭，氤氲暗雨遮朔关。”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' vigilant protection of Jinzhou. "Cast your gaze towards the north, where the city's silhouette fades, its gates veiled by the tranquil rain."

source: 为纪念夜归战士的一往无前而打造的迅刀。有诗赞曰：“千音万阙传惊鼓，百兵一心出云陵。”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' courage. "A thousand echoes carry the war's tale, as spirits unite in resounding gorges of valor.”

source: 为纪念夜归战士的同袍之义而打造的臂铠。有诗赞曰“薄衣难抵霜晨月，铁甲能断星垂寒。”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' comradeship. "Thin garments yield to icy moons, while armor withstands the chill of stars."

source: 为纪念夜归战士的常备不懈而打造的长刃。有诗赞曰：“漫漫长夜秋萧瑟，点点星光负长缨。”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' preparedness. "Autumn fades in endless nights, ready blades gleam with silent might."

source: 为纪念夜归战士的舍生忘死而打造的佩枪。有诗赞曰：“会燃残躯成烈火，焚焰灼尽天下安。”
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' dedication. "Let my body ablaze, flames dance to banish all evil's haze."

source: 人世間的哀樂變幻無端， 痛苦轉瞬就變成了狂歡。

source: 楽譜にインスパイアされ作成した拳銃。音階は、昇順。空を切り裂き雷霆を貫き、絶妙な楽章を紡ぐ。
target: An ascending crescendo. These pistols unleash bullets with the force of thunder, tearing through the heavens like a symphony of destruction.

source: 楽譜にインスパイアされ作成した迅刀。音階は、昇順。抑揚の響を以て華麗なる序曲を奏でる。
target: An ascending crescendo. This enchanting sword effortlessly cuts through anything in its way, like a glorious prelude.

source: 楽譜にインスパイアされ作成した長刃。音階は、降順。異響の力を以て、戦局を制する終わらぬ名作となる。
target: A descending adagio. This broadblade dominates the battlefield with the power of discordance. The curtain never falls on a masterpiece.

source: 此即为血盟之证——永不背叛，永不放弃，直至最后一滴血流尽。
target: This weapon is a testament to the unbreakable blood pact: One shall never betray, never surrender, and fight until the last drop of blood is shed.

source: 此即為血盟之證——永不背叛，永不放棄，直至最後一滴血流盡。
target: This weapon is a testament to the unbreakable blood pact: One shall never betray, never surrender, and fight until the last drop of blood is shed.

source: 武器の外見を変えられる投影アイテム
target: A projection device that allows you to change the weapon's appearance.

source:
死は決して覆らない現実だ。ならば、もはや迷う理由もない。
彼女は引き金を引き、すがりついていた夢を自らの手で撃ち砕く。
target:
Because death is a reality that cannot be undone, there's no reason to hesitate.
She pulls the trigger, shattering this haunting reverie.

source:
死亡的事实无法改变。既然如此，便没有什么好犹豫的。
她扣下扳机，亲手摧毁依存的梦。
target:
Because death is a reality that cannot be undone, there's no reason to hesitate.
She pulls the trigger, shattering this haunting reverie.

source:
死亡的事實無法改變。既然如此，便沒有什麼好猶豫的。
她扣下扳機，親手摧毀依存的夢。
target:
Because death is a reality that cannot be undone, there's no reason to hesitate.
She pulls the trigger, shattering this haunting reverie.

source: 沉重粗犷但却无比可靠的坚实臂铠。在熟练的使用者掌心能爆发出移山填海的惊人力量。
target: A pair of heavy and strong gauntlets with great reliability. It can unleash destructive power to deal fatal blows when equipped by proficient users.

source: 沉重粗獷但卻無比可靠的堅實臂鎧。在熟練的使用者掌心能爆發出移山填海的驚人力量。
target: A pair of heavy and strong gauntlets with great reliability. It can unleash destructive power to deal fatal blows when equipped by proficient users.

source: 沿用了悲鳴前的鍛造技法，看似笨重的刀身使用起來卻相當輕巧。劈斬時伴有嗡嗡迴響，如橫跨亙古的低吟。
target: A pre-Lament forging technique is used, rendering the broadblade lightweight and handy with its cumbersome-looking body. Buzzing sounds can be heard when the wielder slashes, like a croon from time immemorial.

source: 沿用了悲鸣前的锻造技法，看似笨重的刀身使用起来却相当轻巧。劈斩时伴有嗡嗡回响，如横跨亘古的低吟。
target: A pre-Lament forging technique is used, rendering the broadblade lightweight and handy with its cumbersome-looking body. Buzzing sounds can be heard when the wielder slashes, like a croon from time immemorial.

source:
流れる風で刃を打ち、広がる空を鞘とする。その剣が抜かれれば、すべての音は消え去る。
決して褪せることのないその深蒼は、彼女の決意であり、誓いであり、そして理想そのものだ。
target:
Forged of flowing wind, sheathed in the azure sky. Once the blade is drawn, all sound falls still.
That never-fading azure is her resolve, her vow, and her ideal.

source:
流風鑄刃，蒼天為鞘，劍鋒既出，萬籟俱寂。
永不褪色的那抹青藍，是她的決意、誓言與理想。
target:
Forged of flowing wind, sheathed in the azure sky. Once the blade is drawn, all sound falls still.
That never-fading azure is her resolve, her vow, and her ideal.

source:
流风铸刃，苍天为鞘，剑锋既出，万籁俱寂。
永不褪色的那抹青蓝，是她的决意、誓言与理想。
target:
Forged of flowing wind, sheathed in the azure sky. Once the blade is drawn, all sound falls still.
That never-fading azure is her resolve, her vow, and her ideal.

source:
浪海欲讓騎士戴上命定的冠冕，而騎士只將冠冕收入劍中。
那冠冕不會成為騎士的束縛，那浪海也無法停下騎士的腳步。
target:
The surging tides force the crown of thorns upon the knight, out of which the knight forges this sword.
Unburdened by the crown, the knight waded through the roaring waves unwaveringly.

source:
浪海欲让骑士戴上命定的冠冕，而骑士只将冠冕收入剑中。
那冠冕不会成为骑士的束缚，那浪海也无法停下骑士的脚步。
target:
The surging tides force the crown of thorns upon the knight, out of which the knight forges this sword.
Unburdened by the crown, the knight waded through the roaring waves unwaveringly.

source: 海原は、漁民たちの麦畑。その収穫は、希望が実った果実。
target: To fishers, the sea is their field of harvest. Harvest means hope.

source: 激しい火力で名だたる銃。手にして戦場へ行く者は、滾る戦意が沸き立つ。
target: A pair of pistols known for their strong firepower. An impassioned conviction will surge when the shooter holds these pistols on the battlefield.

source: 為紀念夜歸戰士對今州的守護而打造的音感儀。有詩贊曰：「湖城北望荒石嶺，氤氳暗雨遮朔關。」
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' vigilant protection of Jinzhou. "Cast your gaze towards the north, where the city's silhouette fades, its gates veiled by the tranquil rain."

source: 為紀念夜歸戰士的一往無前而打造的迅刀。有詩贊曰：「千音萬闕傳驚鼓，百兵一心出雲陵。」
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' courage. "A thousand echoes carry the war's tale, as spirits unite in resounding gorges of valor.”

source: 為紀念夜歸戰士的同袍之義而打造的臂鎧。有詩贊曰「薄衣難抵霜晨月，鐵甲能斷星垂寒。」
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' comradeship. "Thin garments yield to icy moons, while armor withstands the chill of stars."

source: 為紀念夜歸戰士的常備不懈而打造的長刃。有詩贊曰：「漫漫長夜秋蕭瑟，點點星光負長纓。」
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' preparedness. "Autumn fades in endless nights, ready blades gleam with silent might."

source: 為紀念夜歸戰士的捨生忘死而打造的佩槍。有詩贊曰：「會燃殘軀成烈火，焚焰灼盡天下安。」
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' dedication. "Let my body ablaze, flames dance to banish all evil's haze."

source: 狂風呼嘯，浪濤洶湧。大海將一切吞沒其中，唯有船燈大笑！
target: Blistering winds and crashing waves, the sea devours all. Only a lonely boat lamp stands alight!

source:
狂風呼嘯，浪濤洶湧。大海將一切吞沒其中，唯有船燈大笑！
前進吧，前進吧！一直航行到世界盡頭！
target:
Blistering winds and crashing waves, the sea devours all. Only a lonely boat lamp stands alight!
Onwards! Towards the edge of the world you shall sail!

source: 狂风呼啸，浪涛汹涌。大海将一切吞没其中，唯有船灯大笑！
target: Blistering winds and crashing waves, the sea devours all. Only a lonely boat lamp stands alight!

source:

target:

source:
私はそこにはいないし、死んでもいない。
これから死を追いかけ、悦楽を以て恐怖を覆い隠し、そして未来と引き換えに過去を取り戻す。
target:
I am not there. I do not die.
I shall be death's companion—with euphoric delights I drown my fear, with the coming days I trade for the past.

source: 空に発生する奇象で誕生した長刃。その鍛造者は星々を見た時に感じた情緒をそれと融合させたおかげで、軽やかな見た目に反して、実は隕石墜落如きの重さで敵を潰せる。
target: The Broadblade born from the aerial phenomenon. The blacksmith incorporates the feelings of witnessing the alien star into the weapon, making it look hollow and light, but it can exert the invincible gravity of the starfall.

source:
竹は虚にして実、人は実にして虚。
竹に虚言なく、虚行なく、虚名なし。竹は斯くの如くなれど、人、必ずしも実にあらず。
target:
Bamboo, hollow yet full; People, whole yet seldom true.
Bamboo speaks without deceit, acts without conceit, seeks no vanity. Few ever measure up thus.

source:
竹以虚而实，人因实而虚。
竹不虚言，不虚行，不虚名。竹能如此，人未必实。
target:
Bamboo, hollow yet full; People, whole yet seldom true.
Bamboo speaks without deceit, acts without conceit, seeks no vanity. Few ever measure up thus.

source:
竹以虛而實，人因實而虛。
竹不虛言，不虛行，不虛名。竹能如此，人未必實。
target:
Bamboo, hollow yet full; People, whole yet seldom true.
Bamboo speaks without deceit, acts without conceit, seeks no vanity. Few ever measure up thus.

source: 粗く無骨だが信頼できる強い手甲。手慣れた者はこれで山も海も覆すほどの力を出せる。
target: A pair of heavy and strong gauntlets with great reliability. It can unleash destructive power to deal fatal blows when equipped by proficient users.

source:
純粋な概念の投影によってできた、不可視の増幅器。
心の集域では、武器の外観や形状は表面的なものにすぎず、その概念の核心は戦争のための道具である。
target:
A conceptual projection, a transparent rectifier as if it were made of nothing.
In Somnoire, a weapon's form is but a mirage, while its purpose—a tool of war—holds true as ever.

source: 耳を傾けよう——凍りついた刃から、氷河が蠢く音がする。それは、やがて使い手の思想と合流する氷河。この刀は自分の意思で敵を飲み込んでいく。
target: Pay heed: the frigid blade reveals an icy current, amalgamating into a whirlpool of thoughts. Use this powerful sequence to effortlessly crush your enemies with the Sword.

source: 肌身で感じよう——手甲の内には、今にも暴れだしそうな滾る深淵。名状し難い、抑えきれぬ深淵。さあ、装着し、咆哮せよ。そして狂気を以て敵を潰すのだ。
target: The Gauntlets pulsate with an uncontrollable force, emanating unspeakable anger from the depths of the unknown lake. As you don them, unleash your fury on helpless enemies. Feel its power surge through you.

source: 華胥研究院が源流シリーズを元に改造し作成した、実用的な高性能迅刀。研究院の誇りある過去を象徴している。
target: An improved version of a mass-produced sword model developed in Huanglong. With its sleek blade and minimalist design, this sword is exclusively crafted for the skilled hands of seasoned warriors.

source: 華胥研究院が源流シリーズを元に改造し作成した、実用的な高性能長刃。何物にも破られない、理性と包容の結晶。
target: An improved version of a mass-produced broadblade model developed in Huanglong. With its formidable performance and innovative technologies, this broadblade carries a weight only to be wielded by seasoned warriors.

source: 華胥研究院在此前源能武器的基礎上進行自主改進、研發的第一把極具實用性的高性能迅刀，代表著研究院的過往與發展，歷久彌新。

source: 血の盟約をここに示さん――裏切りも諦めもなし、最後の血の一滴が流れ尽きるまで、この誓いは決して破れぬ。
target: This weapon is a testament to the unbreakable blood pact: One shall never betray, never surrender, and fight until the last drop of blood is shed.

source: 見つめよう——鋭い刃先には、風の冷気が感じられる。生き物のような水面の乱反射。この武器を手に取る者は、その内なるエナジーに抱擁される。
target: Gaze upon this Broadblade, its sharp edges gleaming in the frigid air. Wield it to feel power coursing through you like a raging river.

target: A descending adagio. These gauntlets pulsate with the power of surging waves, shattering anything in their path like a deadly hymn.

source: 그것은 시계처럼 정확하고 안정적이며, 가차없는 업보의 종말을 고한다——모든 죄는 새벽빛이 어둠을 흩날리는 것처럼 불빛 속에서 사라질 것이다
target: It heralds justice, precise and inexorable as a clock's toll. All sins are cleansed in flame, dissipating like night beneath the dawn's gaze.

source:
나는 그곳에 있지 않아. 게다가 아직 살아있어.
난 죽음을 쫓으며 쾌락으로 공포를 가리고 미래로 과거를 맞바꿀 거야
target:
I am not there. I do not die.
I shall be death's companion—with euphoric delights I drown my fear, with the coming days I trade for the past.

source: 뇌전은 그녀의 옛 상처와 연약함을 씻어낼 것이다. 그 피와 모래로 만들어진 용광로에서 그녀는 더 이상 먼지가 아니라 찬란하고 눈부신 태양이 될 것이다
target: Thunder shall purge her pain and weakness. From the crucible of blood and sand, the Sun rises. Not dimmed by dust, but ablaze in her full radiance.

source:
대검 · 태평성대의 개념적 투영, 마치 복숭아꽃처럼 아름답다.
봄바람이 사계절을 흔드니 검의 시간 옥구슬도 소녀의 마음처럼 꽃잎에 물들어 분홍빛이 되었다
target:
A projection of Broadblade - Ages of Harvest, as lovely as peach blossoms.
With spring's arrival, the temporal pearl on the hilt turns pink, dyed by petals, like the heart of a girl in bloom.

source:
대나무는 비어 있기에 그 실재(實在)를 채우고, 사람은 채우려 하기에 도리어 공허해진다.
대나무는 헛된 말을 하지도, 헛된 행동을 하지도, 헛된 이름을 구하지 않는다. 대나무가 이처럼 실재할지라도, 사람은 반드시 그러하지 않다
target:
Bamboo, hollow yet full; People, whole yet seldom true.
Bamboo speaks without deceit, acts without conceit, seeks no vanity. Few ever measure up thus.

source:
모든 법칙은 관측 가능하고, 모든 현상은 해석 가능하다.
수만 광년 너머에 있는 이상에, 두 손이 닿을 수 있듯이
target:
Every pattern can be observed. Every phenomenon can be understood.
The ideal may lie light-years away, yet the path toward it rests within her own hands.

source:
모든 햇빛이 당신을 비추니, 답이 보일 것이다.
해야만 하는 일들이 있고, 당신만이 할 수 있는 일들이 있다.
크게 한 걸음 내디뎌 보자, 태양의 끝에 더 가까이
target:
Sunlight gathers. The answer is made plain.
What must be done awaits. The Rein is in your hand.
Step forward, toward the sunlit end.

source: 무겁고 거칠지만 믿음직스럽게 견고한 권갑, 숙련된 사용자의 손에 착용하면 치명적인 타격을 가할 수 있는 파괴력을 발휘한다
target: A pair of heavy and strong gauntlets with great reliability. It can unleash destructive power to deal fatal blows when equipped by proficient users.

source: 무기 외관을 변경할 수 있는 투영 도구
target: A projection device that allows you to change the weapon's appearance.

source: 바다는 어민들에게 있어 농부의 밀밭과 같고, 수확이 많을수록 희망도 더 커진다
target: To fishers, the sea is their field of harvest. Harvest means hope.

source: 반응 — 강력한 권갑을 통해 마치 알 수 없는 깊은 연못에서 밀려오는 성난 파도가 느껴지며, 그 느낌은 말로 표현할 수 없다. 이 권갑을 착용하면 적에게 내면의 분노를 표출할 수 있다
target: The Gauntlets pulsate with an uncontrollable force, emanating unspeakable anger from the depths of the unknown lake. As you don them, unleash your fury on helpless enemies. Feel its power surge through you.

target: A pre-Lament forging technique is used, rendering the broadblade lightweight and handy with its cumbersome-looking body. Buzzing sounds can be heard when the wielder slashes, like a croon from time immemorial.

source: 수호신에게서 빠진 용비늘로 만든 예기라고 전해지며, 칼보다는 악기에 가깝다
target: Forged from the scale of Jué, this weapon resembles a musical instrument more than a tool of destruction.

source:
순수 개념적 투영, 마치 감지할 수 없는 투명한 권갑.
마음의 영역 중, 무기의 외형적 의미는 단지 표면에만 그칠 뿐, 진정한 핵심은 전투용 도구이다
target:
A conceptual projection, transparent gauntlets as if they were made of nothing.
In Somnoire, a weapon's form is but a mirage, while its purpose—a tool of war—holds true as ever.

target:

In Somnoire, a weapon's form is but a mirage, while its purpose—a tool of war—holds true as ever.

source: 슬픔과 기쁨이 끝없이 반복되는 인간 세상에서는 고통도 순식간에 카니발로 바뀌게 된다
target: The joys and sorrows of life dance in an endless circle; Pain and tears shift in an instant into a carnival.

source: 악보의 주파수를 영감으로 제작한 대검. 음계가 내려앉은 칼을 들면 굉음의 힘으로 전장을 지배한다. 걸작은 영원히 막을 내리지 않는다
target: A descending adagio. This broadblade dominates the battlefield with the power of discordance. The curtain never falls on a masterpiece.

source: 악보의 주파수를 영감으로 제작한 직검. 음계가 올라간 검을 손에 쥐면 아름다운 소리로 화려한 서곡을 작곡할 수 있다
target: An ascending crescendo. This enchanting sword effortlessly cuts through anything in its way, like a glorious prelude.

source:
야귀군을 위해 특별히 제작된 권갑. 야귀 전사의 전우에 대한 의리를 담고 있다.
한 시에서는 이를 「얇은 옷은 서리달의 추위 앞에 무릎을 굽히고, 권갑은 서리별의 추위를 감싸안는다.」라고 찬양한다
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' comradeship. "Thin garments yield to icy moons, while armor withstands the chill of stars."

source:
야귀군을 위해 특별히 제작된 권총. 야귀 전사의 사생결단에 대한 신념을 담고 있다.
한 시에서는 이를 「찬란한 세상의 빛을 위해, 이 한 몸 기꺼이 불태우리라!」라고 찬양한다
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' dedication. "Let my body ablaze, flames dance to banish all evil's haze."

source:
야귀군을 위해 특별히 제작된 대검. 야귀 전사의 꾸준한 양성에 대한 신념을 담고 있다.
한 시에서는 이를 「끝없이 긴 가을밤에, 서러운 바람이 쌩쌩 불고, 희미한 별빛 아래, 출정 준비를 마쳤다.」라고 찬양한다
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' preparedness. "Autumn fades in endless nights, ready blades gleam with silent might."

source:
야귀군을 위해 특별히 제작된 증폭기. 야귀 전사의 금주 수호의 의지가 담겨있다.
한 시에서는 이를 「어두운 밤 자욱한 안개비가 흩날리고 있으니, 호성 황석령의 북쪽 하늘을 뒤덮는구나!」라고 찬양한다
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' vigilant protection of Jinzhou. "Cast your gaze towards the north, where the city's silhouette fades, its gates veiled by the tranquil rain."

source:
야귀군을 위해 특별히 제작된 직검. 야귀 전사의 용감한 전진에 대한 신념을 담고 있다.
한 시에서는 이를 「전쟁을 알리는 북소리가 울려퍼지며, 전사들은 필사즉생의 각오로 협곡을 건넌다.」라고 찬양한다
target: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' courage. "A thousand echoes carry the war's tale, as spirits unite in resounding gorges of valor.”

source:
얼마나 날카로운 칼이어야, 이 끝없는 밤을 단숨에 가를 수 있을까?
그녀는 답을 찾으며 앞으로 나아간다. 기댈 곳 없이 부서진 소원들은 그녀의 피에 스며들어 타오른다
target:
How keen a blade it takes to impale this unrelenting night?
She presses ever forward for the answer, those unbound wishes roaring in her veins.

source:
여러 차례 승리를 불러와 행운이 깃든 직검으로 인정받고 있다.
"그럼, 승리가 당신과 함께 하길"
target: A sword of recognized blessing since it has contributed to countless triumphs. "May victory be with you."

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
target: An error occurred. Please contact Customer Service.

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다

넘쳐나는 모든 색이 한곳에 모이면, 언제나 멀리서 바라봤던 맑은 하늘에 마침내 그녀는 도착한다

Prismatic light dances at her fingertips, arcs of color carving radiant trails.
Every rushing hue converges upon her aim, and at last, she reaches a sky where nothing lies beyond her sight.

죽었다는 사실을 바꿀 수 없다면, 망설일 이유는 없다.

target:
Because death is a reality that cannot be undone, there's no reason to hesitate.
She pulls the trigger, shattering this haunting reverie.

source: 집중 — 날카로운 칼날의 끝부분을 통해 마치 갑자기 불어오는 산들바람과 함께 끝없는 호수가 차가운 은빛 비늘처럼 반짝거리는 모습을 보는 것 같다. 이 대검을 휘둘러 무아의 경지에 이르면 샘물처럼 맑은 칼날 속에 축적된 에너지를 느낄 수 있다
